hook: Engine shafts rely on oil-lubricated journal bearings to prevent direct metal-to-metal contact during rotation.

sections.voiceover: Engine shafts rely on oil-lubricated journal bearings to prevent direct metal-to-metal contact during rotation.

text_overlay.text: Hidden Oil Films in Heavy Engines

sections.voiceover: Yulin Zhang published a study on September 18, 2026, analyzing a 3-disk, 4-support bearing-rotor system. How does shaft bending alter pressure across the 4 supports?
sections.visual_cue: Split screen showing a research paper dated September 18, 2026, alongside a 3D CAD schematic of a 4-support rotor system.
sections.sfx_cue: Page turn digital artifact, then high-tech data blip.
b_roll: CAD animation of a rotor shaft with 4 support bearings
sections.animation_cue: Subtle pan across the 3-disk rotor diagram highlighting the 4 support points.
sections.transition_out: Slide left to stress distribution analysis.

sections.voiceover: However, bending at one support shifts the shaft position across all 4 locations simultaneously.
sections.visual_cue: Dynamic graphical overlay highlighting force vectors shifting across 4 bearing locations simultaneously.
b_roll: Finite element analysis stress map animation
sections.animation_cue: Pulsing red stress rings appearing at each of the 4 bearing supports.
sections.transition_out: Quick cross dissolve to pressure redistribution view.

sections.voiceover: Researchers led by Yulin Zhang proved that shaft flexibility redistributes hydrodynamic support across the system. The oil film pressure shifts dynamically between the 4 supports.
sections.visual_cue: Detailed scientific simulation graphic showing oil film pressure gradients collapsing under shaft deflection.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep structural groan turning into a warning tone.
b_roll: Yulin Zhang research findings data visualization
Engine bearing wear analysis lab footage
sections.animation_cue: Slow push-in on the pressure redistribution graph showing the 4 support nodes.

sections.voiceover: Flexible steel shafts reshape the hidden oil films across all 4 supports.
sections.visual_cue: Wide cinematic shot of a heavy-duty industrial engine rotor operating inside a test facility.
sections.sfx_cue: Engine slowing down to a quiet idle.
b_roll: Heavy-duty engine test facility wide shot
sections.animation_cue: Slow fade to black over the rotating shaft.
